verdict: Leads are coming in efficiently; converting them to appointments is the open problem.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 125 leads at $11.46 cost per lead, entirely through Meta. Spend pulled back about 40% this past week while leads held nearly flat — a real efficiency gain — but the current daily budget keeps overall volume thin. The more important story is downstream: of 125 leads, 84 moved into your pipeline as opportunities, yet zero appointments are recorded, meaning leads are arriving but not being contacted or booked through to a visit. Contact and pipeline cleanup work is in motion now, and a trusted scoreboard is the target by August 31 so you have a clear read on what the leads are actually worth.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days
cost per lead this period — down 38% versus the prior week
appointments logged from 84 open pipeline opportunities this period

watch_item.issue: No appointments are being recorded from an otherwise active pipeline, making it impossible to measure what leads are turning into for your business.
watch_item.fix: Contact records and pipeline sync are being cleaned up now, with a live, trustworthy dashboard targeted for August 31.
